name: Kinetic Full-Characteristic Multivariate Response-Surface Sweep
contextPolicy: all accepted CP148 same-TL Stage-A scenario cells containing exactly one Kinetic main weapon and one non-Kinetic opponent; preserve both side assignments, all five resource environments, all ten strata, and every TL where the opponent family exists

operationalFactors.meaning: delta from executable CP148 Kinetic accuracyPp
delta from executable CP148 Kinetic damage
delta from executable CP148 Kinetic APEN
delta from each executable CP148 resource-environment Kinetic firing TP; preserves the resource ensemble crossing
delta from executable CP148 standard range
delta from maxRange-standardRange; maxRange is recomputed so the range envelope remains legal
absolute Kinetic main magazine depth; CP148 baseline is 100

spaceSweep.reason: Space changes Stage-A legality/headroom but fixed Stage-A combat packages do not automatically spend freed Space on invented AUX; therefore Space is swept as construction feasibility/headroom rather than falsely treated as direct combat DPS

design.description: Per TL: baseline + both directions for every factor + all four low/high combinations for every factor pair + a 64-run seven-factor resolution-VII half fraction (A-F free, G=ABCDEF). This directly estimates main effects and pairwise interactions while also probing higher-dimensional corners without the 3^7 Cartesian explosion.

analysisPolicy: preserve matched scenario identities and trial indices across every candidate; report TL/candidate, opponent, resource, stratum, Armor-role, TP, delivery, Held-Main/PDS, endurance, main-effect, pairwise-interaction, identity-stress, and combat-Pareto surfaces
familyIdentityPolicy: SPEN remains exactly zero. Candidates exceeding contemporary Energy accuracy or range are retained as diagnostic identity-stress points, clearly flagged, and cannot be silently promoted.
spaceInterpretationBoundary: Space is a real Kinetic characteristic and is swept thoroughly for legality/free-space. CP149 does not invent an automatic AUX filler to turn freed Space into combat output; later ship-design research may cross the viable combat candidates with explicit AUX loadouts.
interpretationBoundary: CP149 is a broad response-surface experiment, not a one-knob tweak and not an automatic optimizer. No candidate is promoted by threshold. The purpose is to identify sensitivities, interactions, thresholds, family-identity costs, and viable regions before a later refinement/confirmation pass.
smokeContextPolicy: per TL: every stratum with Energy under R1 central, every stratum with GP Missile under R4 tight, and every stratum with Swarmer under R4 tight where Swarmer exists; one side assignment per smoke cell
